source_obligation.source_statement: REUSE accepted declaration unchanged, with its full existing proof closure; import and audit it in the final joint environment. Original lemma constant lines 176–197, in the canonical inverse-limit presentation of an arbitrary finite affine formal cover: on a proper flat k[[t]] model with smooth geometrically connected generic fiber, compatible rational functions with no height-one poles on noetherian normal parameter-torsion-free formal chart domains come from one unique Laurent scalar through the actual structural maps. Construct the restriction system. Reuse normal_domain_height_one_intersection, proper_formal_functions_h0 and proper_model_global_constants. Semistability is not needed beyond source flatness. No cyclic/chart-algebraization hypothesis is added.
